## Shared components and raw controls

Findings exempted by `xtask/ui-px-allowlist.txt` (canvas geometry, deferred listeners): 6.

Rule `shared-component` only fires for a tag whose shared component exists in `lib/components` (`SHARED_COMPONENTS` in `xtask/src/ui_audit.rs`).

| Raw tag | Raw uses | Shared component present | Candidate names |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `<button>` | 74 | yes | Button, IconButton, ColorSwatch, Toggle, SidebarSection |
| `<input>` | 51 | yes | Input, TextField, TextInput, Checkbox, Toggle, Slider, NumberField |
| `<select>` | 11 | yes | Select, Dropdown |
| `<dialog>` | 0 | yes | Modal, Dialog |

## Documented exceptions

- px: `0` and `1px` (hairlines) are allowed in spacing / font properties; only padding*, margin*, gap, row-gap, column-gap, font-size, line-height and font are checked, in `<style>` blocks and `style=` / `style:` attributes.
- colour: `var(--token)` and colour functions built from `var(...)` are allowed; `href="#anchor"` and `url(#id)` are not colours.
- wording: `100%` followed by a word is flagged unless the line says `offline` (the About statement); a bare `100%` (zoom, CSS) is fine. Proper nouns (Finder, Word, Markdown, ...) are allowed capitals in button labels.
